column2: **Live updates via a debounced watcher.** A `notify`-based filesystem watcher (400 ms debounce, `.git` noise filtered down to HEAD/refs/index movements) emits a single `repo-changed` event; the frontend refreshes status — or everything, when HEAD moved externally. Editing in an IDE or committing from a terminal reflects in the UI within half a second.

column2: **Tauri v2 + libgit2 (git2-rs).** A native Rust engine gives sub-millisecond status/diff operations and avoids shelling out to `git` for hot paths. `vendored-libgit2` keeps builds hermetic across macOS/Windows/Linux. Every command runs on a blocking thread (`spawn_blocking`) so the UI thread never waits on I/O.
